description: Alejandro Fernández-Montes and Damián Fernández Cerero at Universidad de Sevilla publish processed cloud-workload traces from Alibaba, Google and Azure. The description explains CPU, memory, network and disk-use variables and the aggregation used for each provider. Listed CSV files include Alibaba machine-use averages over days one to eight, Google instance-use averages over a month, and an Azure monthly aggregate. The current file names specify 300-second aggregation; the description also discusses finer Alibaba variants that are not separately listed in this deposit. Zenodo supplies the tables and JSON-LD metadata free under CC BY 4.0. Original observation years include Alibaba 2018 and Google 2019; precise geographic locations are not given. The aggregated series can calibrate data-centre demand scenarios but suppress individual-machine variation. Source trace collections are related inputs, while no explicit relationship to an existing catalogue record was confirmed.
